payload.claim: `_new_side`'s docstring says it returns 'each kept line's (start, end) offset in that text, as a parallel list,' but the function only returns the subset of spans whose `kind == "+"` (line 346), i.e. the added lines' offsets, not a list parallel to the full `lines`/kept-line set the first sentence describes. A reader trusting the docstring could wrongly zip the returned offsets against every kept line instead of only the added ones.
